summary: The Head of Data Engineering oversees all data engineering teams and initiatives, ensuring high-performance, scalable, and reliable data systems aligned with business objectives.
responsibilities: Lead multiple data engineering teams and projects
Define strategy for data platform, pipelines, and analytics support
Ensure adoption of best practices for engineering, security, and governance
Manage budgets, resources, and roadmap for data initiatives
Collaborate with C-level executives to align data strategy with business goals

education: 10–15 years of experience in data engineering and leadership

skills_required.name: Expertise in big data, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering
Strategic planning, budgeting, and project management
